turns.question: What was our net revenue for orders placed in September 2026, meaning order amounts minus the amounts of their returns, excluding cancelled orders?
turns.answer: Net revenue (EUR) for 1 to 30 September 2026 was 12,582.75 EUR, computed as revenue minus partner returns as the metric defines it, with returns counted on the day they were recorded rather than on the orders' placement dates. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
